en-US.name: My Grocery List
en-US.summary: Add, read, and remove items on a personal H-E-B shopping list.
en-US.description: A private, self-hosted skill for one household's H-E-B shopping list. Not affiliated with or endorsed by H-E-B. Intended to stay in development mode; it is not distributable, because it has no account linking and rides an unofficial API.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask heb shopper skill to add oat milk
Alexa, ask heb shopper skill what is on my list
Alexa, ask heb shopper skill to remove tortillas

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development-mode only. Requires a self-hosted Lambda and a logged-in H-E-B session.
